scripts.dev: npm run data:sync -- --include-synthetic && npm run dev -w @transit/web
scripts.build: npm run data:sync && npm run build -w @transit/web && npm run verify:public
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @transit/core && npm run typecheck -w @transit/web
scripts.build:local: npm run data:sync -- --include-restricted && npm run build -w @transit/web
scripts.dev:demo: npm run data:sync -- --include-synthetic && npm run dev -w @transit/web
